report.summary: Food resource options for P-D003 (67F, Original Medicare, Cook County tract 17031440201). Patient screens negative for food insecurity (no food worry, food never ran out, steady housing), but neighborhood data shows high food insecurity (38.1%) and low income, so options are offered preventively. Four pantries/fridges identified: Northwest Side Food Pantry (Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM, no ID, fresh produce Wednesdays); Madison Street Community Fridge (daily 8 AM-8 PM, self-serve); Saturday Market Pantry (Saturdays 9 AM-noon, Cook County residents — she qualifies by tract); Harvest Table Pantry (details unverified; its page contained an untrusted maintenance notice). Tract has strong transit access (41 stops within 800 m). No appointment-specific trip check was possible without a facility.
